name: Your page
tagline: A page that gets you found, answers questions and takes bookings

roadmap.note: Next. Mostly assembly of what is already built - it is what turns the modules into one product a customer can be sold.

marketing.summary: Every workspace gets a real page from the moment it is created - your services, your opening hours, a live booking form and an assistant that answers from your own documents. Not a template to fill in: a page that already works, which you then edit.
marketing.audience: Any service business whose customers find them online and then have to phone to get anywhere.

features.title: It exists before you do anything
features.body: Built from what your workspace already knows: your services, your hours, your documents. You edit a headline, not a page builder.

features.title: Booking, not a contact form
features.body: Customers pick a real free slot from your actual diary. No back and forth, no phone tag.

features.title: Answers at 11pm
features.body: The assistant is on the page, answering from your documents, when you are asleep.

features.title: Built to be found
features.body: Server-rendered, fast, and marked up so search engines understand what you do and where you do it.

faq.q: Do I need a website already?
faq.a: No. This is the website, for a lot of businesses. If you do have one, put the chat bubble on it and use this page as your booking link.

faq.q: Can I take payment on it?
faq.a: Not yet. Money going into your account needs a payment setup we are still building, and we would rather say so than half-do it.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Not in the first version. Your page lives at makerbay.app/p/your-business until then.
